notes: The official listing is a server-rendered WordPress page with a GET form action=/careers/job-openings/ containing search, hidden department and hidden location inputs, plus dropdowns whose data-value values populate them. The server-side filter works over the query string: ?search=engineer returned 7 matching cards from the unfiltered 20. The page's admin-ajax.php filter endpoint is broken (it replaces the list with 'No results found'), so use the GET form parameters, not the AJAX call. The company Kula board's filter_options API lists the same canonical offices (New Delhi/Bengaluru/Navi Mumbai/Mumbai) and departments.
evidence: https://neysa.ai/careers/job-openings/ (form method=get action=/careers/job-openings/ with input name=search and hidden name=department/location; 20 cards)
